semantics.function: out equals the number of one bits in in
semantics.timing: pure combinational response to current input after combinational settling; no clock or cycle latency
semantics.reset: no reset port or reset behavior
semantics.transactions: all binary input vectors are legal; no handshake

verification.oracle: independent testbench integer reference counts ones using a shift-and-test loop
verification.directed: all zeros, all ones, each single one, each single zero, alternating patterns, every population count from 0 to 255
verification.timing: compare after combinational settling, with repeated input changes
verification.tools: Icarus -g2012 with explicit dev_tb top and finite compile/run timeouts
verification.success: every comparison matches and simulation emits PASS

specification_ambiguities: X/Z input behavior is unspecified; functional verification covers binary inputs only.
